name: layered-explainer-example
description: Portable, silent, synthetic-data layered educational explainer example

scripts.dev: npm run captions && remotion studio src/index.tsx --no-open
scripts.render: npm run captions && remotion render src/index.tsx LayeredExplainer out/layered-explainer.mp4 --codec=h264 --pixel-format=yuv420p --muted
scripts.verify: npm run captions && npm run typecheck && npm test
